subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic lifecycle-approval policy and require a separate explicit approval before replacing SKILL.md?
rationale: Both unconditional automatic approval and conditional fail-closed replacement are coherent product policies; source and tests can prove implementation correctness, but only maintainers can choose the intended user workflow and continuity threshold.

options.title: Keep conditional safety gate
options.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity replacements while allowing substantially continuous updates to retain automatic approval.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto approval
options.body: Reject structurally invalid proposals but allow every structurally valid update to apply under the existing automatic policy.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require explicit approval for all update proposals, maximizing review visibility at the cost of restoring broader workflow friction.

recommendation.title: Keep conditional safety gate
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only for low-continuity replacements while allowing substantially continuous updates to retain automatic approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the automatic approval behavior whose intended scope is the exact decision under review.
